nodes.name: Telegram Trigger
nodes.notes: Delivered via the public webhook at https://n8n-webhook.deepeshkumar.dev/ (cloudflared tunnel, ADR 0019) -- needs a Telegram API credential assigned after import (bot token from @BotFather). Not included in this file, never checked into git.

nodes.name: Is Authorized Sender?
nodes.notes: Hard-coded to Deepesh's own numeric Telegram user ID -- a bot token alone is not access control, since anyone who finds the bot's username could otherwise message it and query the local models (see ADR 0019's Consequences). Anything from any other sender is silently dropped, not replied to, on the false branch.

nodes.name: Ignore Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Deliberately silent -- no reply sent to an unrecognized sender, so an unauthorized user gets no confirmation the bot exists or responds to anyone.

nodes.name: Ask Ollama
nodes.notes: llama3.1:8b as a reasonable general-purpose default -- swap for any of the 5 models loaded on gpu-node-01 (see the ollama-openwebui README). Remember Ollama needs to be scaled up (replicas: 1) and ComfyUI scaled down first, same GPU-toggle caveat as everywhere else this Ollama Service is used.

nodes.name: Reply on Telegram
nodes.notes: Same Telegram API credential as the Trigger node -- assign after import.
